title: Projects vendor from the brew install, and find it again
objective: On each machine a fixture project vendored with devbin install --into from the brew install finds it again: a bare bin/devbin upgrade and bin/devbin doctor read it through HOMEBREW_PREFIX's opt/devbin/libexec with no machine pointer and no DEVBIN_INSTALL_PREFIX, and an arm holds this on a fixture prefix laid out as Homebrew lays one out, so it runs without brew.
